children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, of great wisdom, the mighty general of the <s>Dharma</s>,
out of compassion for the worlds, questioned the Teacher.
"That which was formerly declared in another <s>sūtra</s> about the world-leader,
the teaching of the future <s>Buddha</s> named <s>Maitreya</s>—
please explain that power and <s>ṛddhi</s> (supernatural ability) which increases all purposes;

children.text: śrotumicchāma eva ca nāyakasya narottama // Mvyā_3 //
children.translated_text: we wish to hear about the Leader, O best of men."
Having heard that, the <s>Bhagavān</s> (Blessed One) said: "Listen, O best of men,

children.text: tasya maitreyabuddhasya vibhavaṃ vyākṛtaṃ mayā // Mvyā_4 //
children.translated_text: the splendor of that <s>Buddha</s> <s>Maitreya</s> has been prophesied by me.
The oceans will recede on all sides by many <s>yojanas</s> (leagues),
and the paths of the <s>cakravartin</s> (universal monarch) will become passable.
<s>Jambudvīpa</s>, all around, will at that time be the abode
and dwelling of all beings, ten thousand <s>yojanas</s> (leagues) in extent.
The people of that land will be doers of good,
non-violent, free from punishment, very prosperous, and fortunate.
The ground will be free from thorns, level, and verdant,
without ridges or hollows, soft like the tip of cotton wool.
Fragrant rice will grow without cultivation, sweet,
and trees bearing garments adorned with various colors will appear.
Trees a <s>krośa</s> (league) in breadth, bending with leaves, flowers, and fruits;
the lifespan at that time will be eighty thousand years.
Beings will be beautiful, strong, and great in body,

children.text: sattvāḥ dakṣāśca niṣkleśā nirdoṣā dirghajīvinaḥ // Mvyā_11 //
children.translated_text: capable, free from afflictions, faultless, and long-lived.
There will be only three diseases: desire, old age, and sluggish digestion;

children.text: pañcaśatatame varṣe pariṇītā ca dārikā // Mvyā_12 //
children.translated_text: and girls will be married at the age of five hundred years.

children.text: tadā ketumatī nāma purī tatra bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: At that time there will be a city named <s>Ketumatī</s>,
the dwelling of beings who act for the welfare of living creatures.
It will be twelve <s>yojanas</s> (leagues) long and seven in breadth,

children.text: nagaraṃ puṇyavacca tat viśuddhañca manoramaṃ // Mvyā_14 //
children.translated_text: that city of merit, pure and delightful.
Its lofty ramparts made of the seven jewels, a <s>krośa</s> (league) in extent,
with gate-towers and arches adorned with various jewels;
they will be built of jeweled bricks,
the moats covered with lotuses and water-lilies, beautified by swans.
Surrounded on all sides by garlands and seven palmyra palms,
the palms made of four kinds of jewels, adorned with nets of small bells.
From those palms, a delightful sound arises from the wind,

children.text: sumadhuro yathā tūryaṃ tacca pañcāṅgasaṃyutaṃ // Mvyā_18 //
children.translated_text: as sweet as the five-fold musical ensemble.
The people in this city who desire the pleasure of rest
will be delighted by those sounds of the palms at that time.
That city will be filled with water-lilies and night-lotuses,
possessing ponds, groves, and gardens—all three will be present.
A king named <s>Śaṅkha</s>, of great splendor, will be there,
lord and ruler of the four continents, a <s>cakravartin</s> (universal monarch) of great might.
Endowed with the seven jewels, master of a fourfold army,

children.text: sahasraṃ hi janiṣyante putrāstadāsya bhūpateḥ // Mvyā_22 //
children.translated_text: a thousand sons will be born to that king.
He will protect the earth up to the shores of the ocean,
that lord of men, ruling with righteous authority.
At that time, four great treasuries will belong to King <s>Śaṅkha</s>,

children.text: ratnānāṃ śatakoṭīnāṃ rājñastadā hi lokyate // Mvyā_24 //
children.translated_text: containing hundreds of <s>koṭis</s> (tens of millions) of jewels for the king.
<s>Piṅgala</s> in <s>Kaliṅga</s>, <s>Pāṇḍuka</s> in <s>Mithilā</s>,
<s>Elapatra</s> in <s>Gandhāra</s>, and <s>Śaṅkha</s> in the city of <s>Vārāṇasī</s>.
That king, well-endowed with these four treasuries,
will be a great hero, risen by the power of a hundred merits.
A <s>brāhmaṇa</s> named <s>Subrahmā</s> will be the chaplain of that king,
learned, master of the four <s>Vedas</s>, he will be his preceptor.
A teacher, keeper of <s>mantras</s>, possessed of memory, gone to the far shore of the <s>Vedas</s>,

children.text: kaiṭabhe sanighaṇṭe ca padavyākaraṇe tathā // Mvyā_28 //
children.translated_text: skilled in the <s>Kaiṭabha</s>, <s>Nighaṇṭu</s>, word analysis, and grammar.

children.text: tadā brahmāvatī nāma tasya bhāryā bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: At that time, his wife will be named <s>Brahmāvatī</s>,
beautiful, graceful, fair-formed, and illustrious.
Having descended from the <s>Tuṣita</s> heaven, <s>Maitreya</s>, the foremost being,

children.text: tasyāḥ kukṣau sa niyataṃ pratisandhiṃ grahīṣyati // Mvyā_30 //
children.translated_text: will certainly take conception in her womb.
Having carried him of great splendor for the full ten months,
the mother of <s>Maitreya</s>, then, in a beautifully flowering garden—

children.text: na niṣaṇṇā nipannā vā sthitā sā dharmacāriṇī /
children.translated_text: neither sitting nor lying down, but standing, that righteous woman,
grasping the branch of a tree, will give birth to <s>Maitreya</s>.
The best of men will emerge from her right side,
like the sun emerging from a peak of clouds, radiating brilliance.
Unstained by the impurities of the womb, like a lotus by water,
he will fill this entire triple world with his radiance.
Then, pleased, the thousand-eyed king of gods, lord of <s>Śacī</s>,

children.text: jāyamānaṃ grahītā ca maitreyaṃ dvipadottamam // Mvyā_34 //
children.translated_text: will receive the newborn <s>Maitreya</s>, the best among bipeds.
Immediately upon birth, he will take seven steps,

children.text: pade pade nidhānañca padmaṃ padmaṃ bhaviṣyati // Mvyā_35 //
children.translated_text: and at every step, a lotus will appear beneath each foot.
Surveying the four directions, he will utter these words:

children.text: iyaṃ me paścimā jāti nāsti bhūyaḥ punarbhavaḥ /
children.translated_text: "This is my final birth; there is no further rebirth.

children.text: na punarabhā gamiṣyāmi nirvāsyāmi nirāsravaḥ // Mvyā_36 //
children.translated_text: I shall not come again; I shall attain <s>nirvāṇa</s>, free from defilements."
"For beings drowned in the ocean of <s>saṃsāra</s>, partakers of suffering,
bound by the fetters of <s>tṛṣṇā</s> (craving), I shall bring liberation."
The gods will hold a white parasol over his head,
and two <s>Nāga</s> kings will bathe him with streams of cool and warm water.
The nurse, receiving him endowed with the thirty-two excellent marks,

children.text: śriyā jvalantaṃ maitreyaṃ mātre samupaneṣyati // Mvyā_39 //
children.translated_text: <s>Maitreya</s> blazing with glory, will present him to his mother.
A delightful palanquin adorned with various jewels—

children.text: ārūḍhāṃ putrasahitāṃ vahiṣyanti ca devatā // Mvyā_40 //
children.translated_text: the gods will carry it, mounted upon it together with the child.
Then, as thousands of musical instruments are played, entering that city,
upon <s>Maitreya</s>'s arrival, a rain of flowers will fall.
Seeing his son endowed with the thirty-two excellent marks,

children.text: pratyavīkṣātha mantreṣu tadā prīto bhaviṣyati // Mvyā_42 //
children.translated_text: <s>Subrahmā</s>, examining the scriptures, will then be delighted.
"Two destinies for the prince are seen in the scriptures:
either a lord of men, a <s>cakravartin</s> (universal monarch), or a <s>Buddha</s>, the best among bipeds."
Having reached his youth, <s>Maitreya</s>, the best of men,

children.text: cintayiṣyati dharmātmā duḥkhitā khalviyaṃ prajāḥ // Mvyā_44 //
children.translated_text: righteous-souled, will reflect: "Indeed, these people are suffering."
With a voice resounding like <s>Brahmā</s>'s, golden-complexioned, of great splendor,
broad-chested, with full shoulders, eyes like lotus petals;
his body will be fifty cubits in height,
and half as much in breadth, of auspicious complexion and stature.
Attended by eighty-four thousand followers,
<s>Maitreya</s> will teach the sacred texts to the people.
Then King <s>Śaṅkha</s> will erect a sacrificial post,
sixteen <s>vyāmas</s> (fathoms) in breadth and a thousand <s>vyāmas</s> in height.
That lord of men will give that sacrificial post adorned with various jewels

children.text: pradāsyati dvijātibhyo yajñaṃ kṛtvā puraḥsaraṃ // Mvyā_49 //
children.translated_text: to the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, having first performed a sacrifice.
That jeweled sacrificial post, delightful, as soon as it is given,
thousands of <s>brāhmaṇas</s> will break it apart at that very moment.
<s>Maitreya</s>, seeing the impermanence of that sacrificial post,

children.text: kṛtasraṃ vicintya saṃsāraṃ pravrajyāṃ rocayiṣyati // Mvyā_51 //
children.translated_text: reflecting on the decaying nature of <s>saṃsāra</s>, will resolve upon renunciation.
"Having gone forth, I shall attain here the immortal state,
and I shall liberate the people from the fear of disease, death, and old age."
Accompanied by eighty-four thousand followers,
<s>Maitreya</s>, the foremost being, will go forth into renunciation.
The <s>Nāga</s> tree will then be his tree of awakening,
its branches rising upward fifty <s>yojanas</s> (leagues).
Sitting beneath it, <s>Maitreya</s>, the best of men,

children.text: anuttarāṃ śivāṃ bodhiṃ samavāpsyati nāyakaḥ // Mvyā_55 //
children.translated_text: the Leader, will attain supreme, auspicious <s>bodhi</s> (awakening).

children.text: yasyāmeva ca rātrau sa pravrajyāṃ niṣkramiṣyati /
children.translated_text: On the very night in which he goes forth into renunciation,

children.text: tasyāṃ eva ca rātrau hi parāṃ bodhimavāpsyati // Mvyā_56 //
children.translated_text: on that very same night he will attain supreme <s>bodhi</s> (awakening).
Then, with speech endowed with eight qualities, that best of men—
He will teach the true <s>Dharma</s>, auspicious and removing all suffering. // Mvyā 57 //
Having seen the joyful people, he will declare the Truths:
suffering, the arising of suffering, the overcoming of suffering, // Mvyā 58 //
and the noble eightfold path, safe and leading to <s>Nirvāṇa</s>;

children.text: taṃ cāpi dharmaṃ saṃśrutya pratipatsyanti śāsane // Mvyā_59 //
children.translated_text: and having heard that <s>Dharma</s>, they will practice according to the teaching. // Mvyā 59 //
In the flower-covered garden there will be an assembly,

children.text: pūrṇaṃ ca yojanaśataṃ parṣattasya bhaviṣyati // Mvyā_60 //
children.translated_text: and the assembly of that one will extend a full hundred <s>yojanas</s> (leagues). // Mvyā 60 //

children.text: śrutvā narapati rājā śaṅkho nāma mahāyaśāḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard, the king of men, the ruler named <s>Śaṅkha</s>, of great renown,
having given immeasurable gifts, will go forth into the homeless life. // Mvyā 61 //
Surrounded by eighty-four thousand,
the lord of men, having gone forth, will undertake the homeless life. // Mvyā 62 //
By this same number, preceded by young men,

children.text: maitreyasya pitā tatra pravrajyāṃ niṣkramiṣyati // Mvyā_63 //
children.translated_text: <s>Maitreya</s>'s father will there go forth into the homeless life. // Mvyā 63 //
Then the householder there, the renowned one named <s>Sudhana</s>,
will go forth, pure of soul, under <s>Maitreya</s>'s instruction. // Mvyā 64 //
And <s>Śaṅkha</s>'s jewel among women, the renowned <s>Viśākhā</s>,
accompanied by eighty-four thousand

body.translated_text: women, having gone forth, will delight in the homeless life. // Mvyā 65 //

children.text: prāṇinaḥ tatra samaye sahasrāṇi śatāni ca /
children.translated_text: Living beings in that time, hundreds of thousands,
will undertake the homeless life under <s>Maitreya</s>'s instruction. // Mvyā 66 //
In this beautifully flowering garden there will be an assembly,

children.text: samantato yojanaśataṃ parṣat tasya bhaviṣyati // Mvyā_67 //
children.translated_text: extending a hundred <s>yojanas</s> all around — such will be his assembly. // Mvyā 67 //
Then the compassionate Teacher, <s>Maitreya</s>, supreme among men,
surveying the assembly, will speak these words: // Mvyā 68 //
'All these by the Lion of the <s>Śākyas</s>, foremost in virtues, the Savior,
indeed by the Protector of the World, having perceived the element of the true <s>Dharma</s>,

children.text: ropitā mokṣamārgeṇa vikṣiptā mama śāsane // Mvyā_69 //
children.translated_text: were planted on the path of liberation and directed to my teaching. // Mvyā 69 //
With parasols, banners, and flags, with incense, garlands, and unguents,

children.text: kṛtvā stūpeṣu satkāraṃ āgatā hi mamāntikam // Mvyā_70 //
children.translated_text: having honored the <s>stūpas</s>, they have come into my presence. // Mvyā 70 //

children.text: saṃghe datvā ca dānāni cīvaraṃ pānabhojanaṃ /
children.translated_text: And having given gifts to the <s>Saṅgha</s> — robes, drink, and food,

children.text: vividhaṃ glānabhaiṣajyaṃ āgatā hi mamāntikam // Mvyā_71 //
children.translated_text: and various medicines for the sick — they have come into my presence. // Mvyā 71 //
Sprinkling with saffron-water and anointing with sandalwood,

children.text: datvā śākyamuneḥ stūpeṣvāgatā hi mamāntikam // Mvyā_72 //
children.translated_text: having offered these at the <s>stūpas</s> of <s>Śākyamuni</s>, they have come into my presence. // Mvyā 72 //
And having undertaken the training precepts in the teaching of the Lion of the <s>Śākyas</s>,

children.text: paripālaya yathābhūtaṃ āgatā hi mamāntikam // Mvyā_73 //
children.translated_text: guarding them as they truly are, they have come into my presence. // Mvyā 73 //
Having observed the <s>upoṣadha</s> (fast-day observance) here — the noble, auspicious, eightfold [fast],
on the fourteenth, the fifteenth, and the eighth day of the fortnight,
and the special fortnight with its eightfold [observance], well-composed — // Mvyā 74 //

children.text: śīlāni ca samādāya saṃprāptāni ca śāsanam /
children.translated_text: and having undertaken the precepts, they have attained the teaching;

children.text: buddhaṃ dharmeṃ ca saṃghaṃ ca sattvāste śāsanaṃ gatāḥ //
children.translated_text: the <s>Buddha</s>, the <s>Dharma</s>, and the <s>Saṅgha</s> — those beings have entered the teaching;

body.text: kṛtvā ca kuśalaṃ karma macchāsanamupāgatāḥ // Mvyā_75 //
body.translated_text: and having performed meritorious deeds, they have come to my teaching. // Mvyā 75 //

children.translated_text: Therefore these beings were sent by him, and by me too they are established,
surrounded by the wise sage, foremost of assemblies, of vast wisdom. // Mvyā 76 //'
Having seen the joyful people, he will declare the Truths,

children.text: śrutvā ca te tato dharmaṃ prāpsyanti padamuttamam // Mvyā_77 //
children.translated_text: and having heard from him the <s>Dharma</s>, they will attain the supreme state. // Mvyā 77 //
By three miracles (<s>prātihārya</s>) he will discipline the disciples;
all of them will there destroy their <s>āsravas</s> (defilements), delighting. // Mvyā 78 //
The first great assembly of his disciples will take place,
complete with ninety-six <s>koṭis</s> (ten millions) of disciples who have cut through existence. // Mvyā 79 //
The second great assembly of his disciples will take place,
complete with ninety-four <s>koṭis</s> of peaceful ones of vast wisdom. // Mvyā 80 //
The third great assembly of his disciples will take place,

children.text: pūrṇāḥ dvāviṃśati koṭyaḥ śāntānāṃ śāntacetasāṃ // Mvyā_81 //
children.translated_text: complete with twenty-two <s>koṭis</s> of peaceful ones of peaceful minds. // Mvyā 81 //
Having turned the Wheel of the <s>Dharma</s> and having disciplined gods and men,

children.text: sārdhaṃ śrāvakasaṃgheṇa pure piṇḍaṃ cariṣyati // Mvyā_82 //
children.translated_text: together with the assembly of disciples, he will walk for alms in the city. // Mvyā 82 //
Then, as he enters that beautiful city of <s>Ketumatī</s>,
<s>Māndārava</s> flowers will rain down upon that supreme city;

body.text: devatāḥ prakiriṣyanti tasmin puragate munau // Mvyā_83 //
body.translated_text: the deities will scatter them upon the sage who has entered the city. // Mvyā 83 //

children.translated_text: The four great kings, <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the thirty gods,

children.text: brahmā devagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ pūjāṃ tasya kariṣyati // Mvyā_84 //
children.translated_text: and <s>Brahmā</s> together with hosts of gods will pay homage to him. // Mvyā 84 //
Blue lotuses, night-lotuses, lotuses, white lotuses, fragrant flowers,

children.text: aguruṃ candanaṃ cāpi divyaṃ mālyaṃ patiṣyati // Mvyā_85 //
children.translated_text: <s>aguru</s> (aloe-wood), sandalwood, and divine garlands will rain down. // Mvyā 85 //
The <s>devaputras</s> (divine sons) of great supernatural power will cast garments,
gazing upon that Protector of the World as he enters the supreme city. // Mvyā 86 //
And divine music will sound forth, and divine garlands will rain down;

children.text: devatā prakiriṣyanti tasmin puragate munau // Mvyā_87 //
children.translated_text: the deities will scatter them upon the sage who has entered the city. // Mvyā 87 //

children.text: ye tu ketumatīṃ kecit vāsayaṣyanti mānuṣāḥ /
children.translated_text: And whatever people will dwell in <s>Ketumatī</s>,

children.text: tepi taṃ pūjayiṣyanti praviśantaṃ purottamam // Mvyā_88 //
children.translated_text: they too will honor him as he enters the supreme city. // Mvyā 88 //
On the path, they will spread ground-coverings soft as cotton,

children.text: vicitrañca śubhaṃ mālyaṃ vikiriṣyanti te tadā // Mvyā_89 //
children.translated_text: and varied and beautiful garlands they will scatter then. // Mvyā 89 //
With parasols, banners, and flags the people will honor him,
and with auspicious sounds of music, men of joyful minds. // Mvyā 90 //

children.text: taṃ ca śakraḥ sahasrākṣo devarājaḥ śacīpatiḥ /
children.translated_text: And <s>Śakra</s>, the thousand-eyed, king of the gods, lord of <s>Śacī</s>,

children.text: prahṛṣṭaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā maitreyaṃ stoṣyate jinam // Mvyā_91 //
children.translated_text: rejoicing, with palms joined, will praise <s>Maitreya</s>, the Conqueror: // Mvyā 91 //
'Homage to you, noblest of men! Homage to you, supreme among men!
Have compassion on the people, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, foremost of beings!' // Mvyā 92 //
A <s>devaputra</s> of great supernatural power will be his <s>Māra</s>;

children.text: sa cāpi prāñjalirbhūtvā stoṣyate lokanāyakam // Mvyā_93 //
children.translated_text: even he, with palms joined, will praise the World-Leader. // Mvyā 93 //
Surrounded by thousands from the <s>Śuddhāvāsa</s> (Pure Abodes) heavens

children.text: pravekṣyate ca maitreyo lokanātho vināyakaḥ // Mvyā_94 //
children.translated_text: and by many others, <s>Maitreya</s>, the Protector of the World, the Guide, will enter. // Mvyā 94 //
And <s>Brahmā</s>, with a retinue of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, with clear speech,
will proclaim the true <s>Dharma</s>, raising the <s>Brahma</s>-voice. // Mvyā 95 //
The entire earth will be filled with <s>Arhats</s> (worthy ones),
whose defilements are destroyed, whose faults are expelled, whose bonds of existence are severed. // Mvyā 96 //
Rejoicing — gods, men, <s>gandharvas</s> (celestial musicians), <s>yakṣas</s> (nature spirits), and <s>rākṣasas</s> (demons),

children.text: śāstuḥ pūjāṃ kariṣyanti nāgāścāpi maharddhikāḥ // Mvyā_97 //
children.translated_text: and <s>nāgas</s> (serpent deities) of great supernatural power will pay homage to the Teacher. // Mvyā 97 //
They will surely become free from sin, with doubts cut away,
with moats cast up, steadfast, without grasping, without attachment,

body.translated_text: and they will practice the holy life under <s>Maitreya</s>'s instruction. // Mvyā 98 //

children.translated_text: They too will surely become without selfishness, without possessions,
without gold and silver, homeless, without intimacy,
and they will practice the holy life in <s>Maitreya</s>'s instruction. // Mvyā 99 //

children.text: te vai pāraṃ gamiṣyanti chitvā jālameva bhujāt /
children.translated_text: They will indeed go beyond, having cut the net as if by the arm;
and having attained the <s>dhyānas</s> (meditative absorptions), endowed with joy and happiness,
they will practice the holy life under <s>Maitreya</s>'s instruction. // Mvyā 100 //
For sixty thousand years, <s>Maitreya</s>, supreme among bipeds,
the Teacher, out of compassion for the world, will teach the true <s>Dharma</s>. // Mvyā 101 //

children.text: śatāni ca sahasrāṇi prāṇiṇāṃ sa vināyakaḥ /
children.translated_text: Hundreds of thousands of living beings — that Guide,
having disciplined them through the <s>Dharmakāya</s> (body of the Dharma), will then attain <s>Nirvāṇa</s>. // Mvyā 102 //
And when that steadfast one, <s>Maitreya</s>, supreme among bipeds, has attained <s>Nirvāṇa</s>,
the true <s>Dharma</s> will remain on earth for ten thousand years. // Mvyā 103 //
Therefore, let your minds be filled with faith in the Conqueror <s>Śākyamuni</s>;
then you shall see <s>Maitreya</s>, the Fully Awakened One, supreme among bipeds. // Mvyā 104 //

children.text: tasmāddharme ca buddhe ca saṃghe cāpi gaṇottame /
children.translated_text: Therefore, in the <s>Dharma</s>, in the <s>Buddha</s>, and in the <s>Saṅgha</s>, the supreme assembly,
let your minds be filled with faith — the result will be of great supernatural power. // Mvyā 105 //
Having in time honored that compassionate one, <s>Maitreya</s>, supreme among bipeds,
you shall then attain <s>Nirvāṇa</s>. // Mvyā 106 //
Having heard this marvelous account and seen the prosperity, however small,

children.text: ko vidvānna prasīdeta api kṛṣṇāsu jātiṣu // Mvyā_107 //
children.translated_text: what wise person would not be filled with faith, even among those of low birth? // Mvyā 107 //
Therefore, one who desires his own welfare, aspiring to greatness,
should hold the true <s>Dharma</s> in high regard, remembering the teaching of the <s>Buddha</s>. // Mvyā 108 //
